title: LISA Foundation
services: Creative Direction, Product Design, UX & Strategy
summary: Collective ownership of blue-chip art — from as little as $1.
cover_alt: The LISA wordmark projected in an empty gallery room
intro: LISA Foundation is the first platform for collective ownership and governance of physical art. Using blockchain, LISA utilises fractional ownership to allow investors to purchase physical blue-chip artworks from as little as $1.
Breaking into the art market is hard for beginner collectors: waitlists last for years, the best deals happen behind closed doors and maintenance fees are high. LISA set out to open it up.
outcomes: For 2+ years BS led product and digital design at LISA Foundation, helping them scale from idea to MVP and beyond.

We shaped the end-to-end collector experience — curated discovery, fractional purchase and ownership — across web and mobile, alongside the tokenomics and customer-journey mapping that underpins the platform.

title: Erria
summary: A marketplace connecting buyers directly with independent makers and designers.
cover_alt: Erria brand identity and marketplace homepage designs
intro: Erria is a platform built to support creative work and the people behind it, connecting buyers directly with independent makers and designers.

As they prepared to scale, Erria asked us to help translate their mission of transparency, equity and community into a sharper brand identity and digital presence that could drive growth while staying true to their values.
outcomes: BS led the full creative direction for this evolution, delivering a refreshed brand system and modular identity that works seamlessly across social media, storefront and packaging.

We designed and launched Erria 2.0, a brand new e-commerce marketplace that creates a more intentional sales ecosystem between buyers and sellers. Alongside this, we developed a new landing page to articulate their mission and showcase products with clarity.
The result is a cohesive brand and practical toolkit that empowers Erria to communicate their purpose while making it easier for buyers to discover, shop and collect meaningfully.

title: Glaze — Calling All Virgins
services: Creative Direction, Campaign, Brand System, Art Direction
summary: Repositioning Super Gloss as the perfect first time for never-coloured hair.
cover_alt: Glaze ‘Calling All Virgins’ billboard above a city rooftop
intro: Glaze challenged us to unlock an overlooked audience hiding in plain sight: the 20 to 30 percent of women under 35 who have never coloured their hair.

The insight was simple but powerful. These “hair virgins” were not avoiding colour forever, they were avoiding the damage, commitment and mess they associated with it. We repositioned Glaze’s Super Gloss as the perfect first time — a no-damage, semi-permanent gloss that works in 10 minutes and delivers high-shine, commitment-free results.
outcomes: BS led the full creative direction for the Virgins campaign, shaping the concept, messaging and visual language from the ground up.
We delivered a bold new brand design system including an exclusive Virgin Blue palette, refined typography, art direction and product photography.
Our team executed a full brand refresh across digital, social media, point of sale and packaging, and developed a 12-week social-first campaign with paid ads and influencer content.

title: Decathlon — Design Égalité
services: Service Design, Identity Design, Design Strategy
summary: An innovation framework to move people through the wonders of sport.
cover_alt: The Design Égalité app splash screen on a phone inside a Decathlon campus
intro: Decathlon partnered with SKEWED to help define a new internal framework for innovation through the lens of Design Égalité.

The challenge was to create a compelling methodology that could align teams around the cultural importance of sports, movement and design while encouraging a more experimental, future-facing approach to product and retail thinking. Rather than focusing on a single outcome, the project explored how storytelling, systems thinking and immersive experiences could become tools for driving long-term innovation across the business.
outcomes: BS supported SKEWED across the strategic and creative development of the initiative, helping shape the experience narrative, visual storytelling and presentation framework used to communicate the methodology internally.
Together, we developed a five-step innovation model designed to guide teams through ideation, validation and rollout, alongside a toolbox covering process, collaboration and implementation strategy.
The result was a scalable internal design framework that positioned Design Égalité as a catalyst for future innovation across Decathlon.

title: Figma Slides × BS — The Infinite Scroll
summary: A community template for the launch of Figma Slides.
cover_alt: The Infinite Scroll title slide — embossed parchment between chrome scroll handles
intro: For the launch of Figma Slides, BS were asked to collaborate and launch a new template for the community, showcasing the power of the tool and its potential applications.
outcomes: We created The Infinite Scroll — an ancient-manuscript inspired template with embossed parchment, chrome scroll handles and built-in text effects.
Slides push seamlessly into one another, so a deck becomes a single continuous story: add as many slides as you need, end with your logo or a short message — or keep going, forever.

title: Decathlon — Wonderland
services: Event Identity, Experience Design, App & Screen Design
summary: 48 hours of sports wonder at the Festival of Innovation Exchange 2024.
cover_alt: ‘Welcome to Wonderland’ key visual — two people resting on a surreal mountainside
intro: The Innovation Exchange Festival presents: 48 hours of sports wonder. For Decathlon’s 2024 Festival of Innovation Exchange, the brief was to create a world that would pull teams out of the everyday and into a more playful, imaginative frame of mind.
outcomes: We built Wonderland — a fluid, dreamlike identity spanning key visuals, posters, wayfinding and signage.
The world extended into a companion festival app and large-format screens, guiding attendees through workshops, talks and daily meditations across the event.

title: Meadow
services: Brand Identity, Symbol System, Art Direction, Packaging, Social
summary: A living system — the identity for a focus brand built around Micro and Macro.
cover_alt: Fisheye photograph of a flower field with the Meadow symbol at its centre
intro: Meadow is an ecosystem — the culture, the community, the conversation — built around two products, Micro and Macro, that help you focus inward or expand outward.
Micro is for deep focus, balance and clarity; Macro is for perspective and reflection.
outcomes: We built the identity around the idea of a living system: calm and simple above ground, with a network of connection and growth below.
The system spans the wordmark and symbol, fisheye campaign photography, app icons, a brushed-metal tin, holographic and kraft packaging, Macro/Micro posters and social.

title: Regent+Rose
services: Brand Identity, Packaging, Art Direction, E-commerce
summary: A day-and-night skincare brand, built from the wordmark up.
cover_alt: Regent+Rose skincare bottles on a marble plinth by the sea
intro: Regent+Rose is a Miami-based skincare brand built around a simple daily ritual: Day and Night essentials powered by ingredients like propolis, royal jelly, centella and snow mushroom.
outcomes: We designed the brand from the wordmark up — a bold, scalable identity system and a ‘+R’ monogram — and carried it across a complete packaging range, from gel cleanser to peptide moisturiser.
Art direction for product and lifestyle photography set the tone for social and the e-commerce site, with a Day and Night colour world that makes the range easy to navigate.

title: amika: connect
services: Event Identity, Stage & LED Environment, Presentation System, Merch, Brand Playbook
summary: Game Time at the House of amika — the identity and world for amika’s annual conference.
cover_alt: The amika: connect lockup on a pink-to-orange gradient
intro: amika:connect is amika’s annual company conference — a moment to come together, reflect, share ideas, celebrate progress and align around what comes next.
For 2026 the team gathered at the Hyatt Regency Hill Country in San Antonio under the theme “Game Time at the House of amika”.
outcomes: We built the whole conference world: a flexible amika:connect lockup, gradient key visuals, dot-matrix GAMEDAY typography and a stage and LED environment that wrapped every session.

The system carried through presentations, name badges and merch — jerseys numbered with each employee’s start year, Accolades varsity jackets and custom patches — all documented in a brand playbook for the team.

title: Emma Reicher
services: Brand Identity, 3D World, Website, Brochures, Social
summary: A brand world for a Chi Kung and BodyMind practice — outgrowing your relationship to your mind.
cover_alt: The Emma Reicher wordmark over a sunlit forest path
intro: Emma Reicher is a Chi Kung teacher and BodyMind practitioner whose work speaks to people who sense there is more to reality than thought — an invitation to outgrow your relationship to your mind.
outcomes: We built a brand world around The Totem: a family of sculptural, shape-shifting forms rendered in many materials, paired with an elemental colour system — Wood, Water, Earth, Metal and Fire.

The identity extends into a website of frosted-glass panels over open landscapes, programme “portals” such as Dreams Decoded and Vision Quest, brochures and Instagram templates for the Chi Kung Collective.
